title: An evidence judge's verdicts (plan J1-J5): evidence-judgement.json (judge A) / evidence-judgement-2.json (judge B)
description: The judge fills only the judgement slots: the driver's facts (judge-facts.json) settle what is determinable and the judge cannot overrule them. PASS and FAIL need a requirement citation and an evidence citation, each a resolvable file:line with a quote found verbatim there. ESCALATE is for business, infra or critical-logic questions only, asked in the batch with sdlc ask.

routeTo.description: FAIL: the node that owns the fix (coding, testcase, execute-and-evidence)

uncoveredFiles.description: EVD-E: per changed source file no case observes, why that is acceptable (with a citation) or FAIL
